stem:
Kabir joins two identical cells for a small radio. He wants a working battery.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: A working battery joins the positive terminal of one cell to the negative terminal of the next.
Two cells joined that way can give the radio energy for a longer time and/or more energy than one cell alone.
Joining the positive terminal of one cell to the positive terminal of the next also makes a working battery.

teacher.key_rationale: A working battery needs opposite terminals joined (+ to −). Same-sign joining (+ to +) does not make a working battery. Extra cells joined correctly can supply more energy or longer use.
